location_id PK

# Airline (flight) review fact. Grain: one row per review submission. Measures are the seven 1-5 category ratings plus the derived average_rating and rating_band.
airlines_reviews__fct_airline_review
-
# Primary key - review identifier from the source.
review_id PK
# FK to dim_airline.
airline_id FK >- conformed__dim_airline.airline_id
# FK to dim_customer.
customer_id FK >- conformed__dim_customer.customer_id
# FK to dim_date - date the review was submitted.
date_submitted_id FK >- conformed__dim_date.date_id
# FK to dim_date - date of the flight; null when not stated.
date_flown_id FK >- conformed__dim_date.date_id
# FK to dim_location - departure airport.
origin_location_id FK >- airlines_reviews__dim_location.location_id
# FK to dim_location - arrival airport.
destination_location_id FK >- airlines_reviews__dim_location.location_id
# FK to dim_location - layover airport; resolves to 'unknown' for direct flights.
transit_location_id FK >- airlines_reviews__dim_location.location_id
# FK to dim_aircraft.
aircraft_id FK >- conformed__dim_aircraft.aircraft_id
# Whether Skytrax marked the review as a verified trip.
is_verified
# Cabin flown: Economy Class, Premium Economy, Business Class, First Class or unknown.
seat_type
# Trip type: Solo Leisure, Couple Leisure, Family Leisure, Business or unknown.
type_of_traveller
# True when a transit airport was recorded.
has_layover
seat_comfort
cabin_staff_service
food_and_beverages
inflight_entertainment
ground_service
wifi_and_connectivity

# Whether the reviewer would recommend the airline.
recommended
# Mean of the category ratings actually scored; null when none were.
average_rating
# average_rating bucketed into bad (<2), medium (<4), good (>=4) or unknown.
rating_band
# Free-text review body.
review_text
# Source updated_at; the high-water mark driving incremental loads.
source_updated_at
# Timestamp this row was last written by dbt.
dbt_loaded_at
